进一步分析后，[Leader.GetName]确认[Planet.GetName]上的岩浆海正在释放珍稀的异星天然气。这一意外发现表明，若能成功开发，该行星或将成为我方工业的潜在资源供给。
texts.en:
Chemical fluctuations in the atmosphere were confirmed across both time and the surface. The fluctuations were strongest over the planet's large ocean of exposed magma, so a probe was dispatched to collect samples.

Upon closer analysis, [Leader.GetName] determined that the magma ocean on [Planet.GetName] is outgassing valuable exotic gasses. This unexpected finding suggests that the planet could be a potential contributor to our industries, if we are able to exploit it.
